_meta.note: What's new in AKKI — surfaced on Home 1.

items.title: Compilation Wizard — commission Agent Cycle in four steps
items.summary: A new sticky rail and 4-step modal let you compile board packs, decks, reports and briefings end-to-end. Pick a template, select sources, confirm contributors, set cadence, ship.

items.title: Work Studio — six tabs, per-tab actions, calmer chrome
items.summary: Board Packs · Minutes · Committee Packs · Decks · Reports · Briefing. Universal Quick Action row removed; each tab now carries its own contextual actions.

items.title: Cycle Manager — multi-cycle support and full-width rows
items.summary: Run multiple agendas in parallel per context. CycleCard is now a full-width row with a readiness numeral and an intel strip.
